blocks.text:
The following example demonstrates how to print some input from a user interface
using `PrintOperation`. It shows how to implement
`on_begin_print` and `on_draw_page`,
as well as how to track print status and update the print settings.
blocks.zh: 下面的示例演示了如何用 `PrintOperation` 打印用户界面中的一些输入。它展示了如何实现 `on_begin_print` 和 `on_draw_page`，以及如何跟踪打印状态和更新打印设置。

blocks.text:
The following example demonstrates how to print some input from a user
interface using `PrintDialog`. The user interface is
similar to the previous example.
blocks.zh: 下面的示例演示了如何用 `PrintDialog` 打印用户界面中的一些输入。其用户界面与前一个示例相似。
